description: Address review feedback: add SHA-256 hash logging of raw input for forensic correlation when sanitization alters the message in chat_stream.
steps: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, import hashlib at the top of the file.
After the sanitize_user_input call in chat_stream, add a conditional debug log that includes a truncated SHA-256 hash of the raw message when sanitization altered it.
acceptance_criteria: hashlib is imported at the top of chat.py
When sanitized_message differs from request.message, a log entry is emitted with the first 16 chars of the SHA-256 hash of the raw message
The log includes user_id and raw_hash in the extra dict
No log is emitted when the message was not altered by sanitization
findings: Added hashlib import and conditional log in chat_stream. When sanitize_user_input alters the message, logs 'input_sanitized' with first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 hash of raw input for forensic correlation. Backend tests: 112 passed, 16 failed (same pre-existing baseline).
